title: KAIROX Security Incident
description: A security incident identified by KAIROX.

display_id.description: Human-readable label shown in the UI (INC-001). Optional because incident_id is the machine id; live incidents may have no label yet. Added to let demo records use readable labels without weakening the uuid rule on incident_id.

risk_level.description: Incidents cannot be 'info'. Mirrors ThreatIncident.severity: Exclude<Risk, "Info"> in src/types.ts.

origin.description: Identifies whether this incident is simulated or from real monitoring.
